smi: smi — to report, announce; to make petition (verb); report, petition (noun)
m-bꜣḥ: m-bꜣḥ — in the presence of, before (compound preposition; m 'in' + bꜣḥ 'presence', written with the phallus sign)
ẖrt: ẖrt — what belongs to someone, affairs, concerns; possessions (noun)
ẖt: ẖt — body, belly; (of gods and people) the person, self (noun)
smtr: smtr — to examine, question; to bear witness (verb; causative of mtr 'be witness')
ꜥḥꜥ: ꜥḥꜥ — to stand, stand up (verb); standing-place, stand, support (noun; plural ꜥḥꜥw)
ẖnw: ẖnw — the inside, interior (noun); m ẖnw 'within'
gꜣiw: gꜣiw — some plants, bushes or a thicket (noun; sense uncertain; Budge: 'amaranthine bushes')
qꜣ: qꜣ — high, exalted (adjective; verb qꜣi 'be high'); as a noun, 'the High One'
iꜣt: iꜣt — standard, the pole or perch carrying a god's emblem; mound (noun)
ꜣtf: ꜣtf — the atef-crown, the tall plumed crown of Osiris (noun)
nfw: nfw — breath, wind (noun; written with the sail, which also writes ṯꜣw 'wind, breath')
m-ꜥ: m-ꜥ — from, from the hand of; through, by (compound preposition; m + ꜥ 'arm')
nꜣy: nꜣy — the … of (possessive article of later Egyptian, with a suffix: nꜣy·k 'your', plural)
wpwty: wpwty — messenger (noun; plural wpwtyw; from wpwt 'message, errand')
wdi: wdi — to put, place, cast; to inflict (verb)
ṯms: ṯms — harm, injury, wrong (noun; plural ṯmsw; a rare word)
sḫpr: sḫpr — to bring into being, create; to bring about (verb; causative of ḫpr)
idryt: idryt — punishment, affliction (?) (noun; sense uncertain; Budge: 'calamities')
iwty: iwty — who has not, which has not; without (negative relative adjective)
ṯꜣmt: ṯꜣmt — covering, veil (noun; cf. the verb ṯꜣm 'to cover, veil')
wꜥb: wꜥb — to be pure, clean; to purify oneself, bathe (verb); pure (adjective)
ḥꜣty: ḥꜣty — heart, breast (noun; the forepart of a lion sign)
pḥwy: pḥwy — hinder parts, back, rear; end (noun)
twr: twr — to be clean, pure; to cleanse, purify (verb)
nn: nn — not, there is not (negative particle; nn + noun 'there is no …') · a second word of the same spelling: these, those (demonstrative, before its noun: nn tꜣw 'these lands')
šw: šw — empty, lacking, free (of) (adjective; verb šwi 'be empty')
rsy: rsy — southern (nisba adjective, from rsw 'south'; feminine rsyt)
snḥm: snḥm — locust, grasshopper (noun; plural snḥmw; sḫt snḥmw 'the Field of the Grasshoppers')
qdty: qdty — the Qedty, divine beings who bathe in the Field of the Grasshoppers (name; reading and sense uncertain; Budge: qeti, 'the divine sailors')
·s: ·s — she, her, it (3rd person feminine singular suffix pronoun; the folded cloth or the bolt)
snꜥꜥ: snꜥꜥ — to make smooth, polish (verb); snꜥꜥ ib 'smooth the heart', soothe, please
m-ḫt: m-ḫt — after (compound preposition; before a verb, 'after he has …')
swꜣ: swꜣ — to pass, pass by (verb; swꜣ ḥr 'pass by'; written with the crossed sticks and walking legs)
tr: tr — then, pray (enclitic particle that presses a question)
tw: tw — you (2nd person masculine singular dependent pronoun)
pw: pw — this, that (demonstrative); '(it) is' in sentences 'X pw' ; also the interrogative 'who? what?' (pw tr 'what then?')
ḥꜣyt: ḥꜣyt — some plant or thicket (noun; sense uncertain; Budge: 'flowers')
bꜣq: bꜣq — the moringa tree, which gives ben-oil (noun; Budge: 'olive')
ḥr-ꜥ: ḥr-ꜥ — at once, forthwith (adverb; lit. 'upon the arm')
pty: pty — what? (interrogative pronoun; pty tr 'what then?')
ḫnd: ḫnd — leg, shin (noun; reading uncertain; cf. ḫnd 'tread')
ihhy: ihhy — rejoicing, jubilation, the cry of joy (noun)
fnḫw: fnḫw — the Fenkhu, a people of Syria and the Levant coast (name of a people; Budge: Fenkhu)
bs: bs — flame (noun; sense from the flame classifier)
sḏt: sḏt — fire, flame (noun; written with the crossed sticks, sḏ)
wꜣḏ: wꜣḏ — papyrus stem; papyrus-shaped column, sceptre or amulet; (adjective) green, fresh (noun; Budge: 'tablet')
ṯḥnt: ṯḥnt — faience, glazed ware; something gleaming (noun; Budge: 'crystal')
wdb: wdb — riverbank, shore; the land along the river (noun)
wꜣs: wꜣs — the was-sceptre, a staff with an animal head and forked foot (noun)
šd: šd — to take, take away, take out; to rescue; to recite, read out (verb)
sw: sw — he, him, it (3rd person masculine singular dependent pronoun)
irf: irf — then, now (enclitic particle, in questions; from r + ·f)
pꜣ: pꜣ — the (masculine definite article of later Egyptian; fem. tꜣ, plural nꜣ)
hꜣtw: hꜣtw — to cry out, utter (?) (verb; a word not otherwise known, written with the man with hand to mouth; Budge: 'uttered words')
mr: mr — canal, pool (noun; Budge reads maa)
